register.description: Description Register. This register provides IP module ID, revision information, instance index and standard MMR registers offset.

bitfield.description: Module identification contains a unique peripheral identification number.

Standard IP MMR block offset. Standard IP MMRs are the set of from aggregated IRQ registers till DTB. 0: Standard IP MMRs do not exist 0x1-0xF: Standard IP MMRs begin at offset of (64*[STDIPOFF] from the base IP address)
IP Instance ID number. If multiple instances of IP exist in the device, this field can identify the instance number (0-15).
Major revision of IP
Minor revision of IP

register.description: Extended Description Register.This register describes the configuration of VIMS.

bitfield.description: Number of Flash banks
FLASH size in Kilo Bytes. The total FLASH size is (FLSZ + 1) KB
ROM size in Kilo Bytes. The total ROM size is (ROMSZ + 1) KB

register.description: Flash Wait State 1T. This register is used to specify the number of waitstates necessary for accessing the flash in 1T mode.

bitfield.description: Flash read wait states for 1T accesses

register.description: Flash Wait State 1T. This register is used to specify the number of waitstates necessary for accessing the flash in 2T mode. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash read wait states for 2T accesses

register.description: FLASH Pump trim Bank 0. This register stores different PUMP trims. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash charge pump trim value.

register.description: FLASH Bank 0 Trim [31:0]. This register stores different bank trims. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash bank trim value.

register.description: FLASH Bank 1 Trim [31:0]. This register stores different bank trims. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash bank trim value.

register.description: FLASH Bank 2 Trim [31:0]. This register stores different bank trims. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash bank trim value.

register.description: Flash Block. This register is used to block user read, write and erase operation to flash. This register is sticky 1 and writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Flash Access

register.description: Configuration Register. This register is used for VIMS configuration. This register is writable only when [CFG.LOCK] is 1

bitfield.description: Split Mode. The logical address space is split into two equal regions
ROM Read Protection Disable
This bit is used to enable flash test mode.
TRIM Valid. This bit indicates if flash charge pump and bank trim values are as applicable.
Lock. Lock VIMS configuration. This bit is sticky '0' and when 0 write protects following registers FLWS1T FLWS2T PTRMC0 B0TRMC0 B1TRMC0 B2TRMC0 FLBLCK CFG

bitenum.description: Configuration registers are locked for writing
Configuration registers are open for writing

register.description: Read Protect Main. First 8KB of flash main region can be protected with granularity of 1KB. This register is sticky 0

bitfield.description: Data Flash Main protection configuration value. Undefined values will read protect whole protectable region or whole data flash; For 4KB paperspin option, values from 12(0xB) to 0(0x0) will protect whole 4KB data flash
Program Flash Main protection configuration value. Undefined values will read protect whole protectable region

register.description: Read Protect Non-Main regions.

bitfield.description: Metadata read protection configuration. 1024 bytes of Metadata can be protected with granularity of 32Bytes. Protection is disabled for 63(0x3F). The values ranging from 32(0x20) to 62(0x3E) will protect 32B spaces in the region. Values from 0(0x00) to 31(0x1F) will protect whole region. This field is sticky 0.

KEY1 read protection configuration. 1024 bytes of KEY1 can be protected with granularity of 32Bytes. Protection is disabled for 63(0x3F). The values ranging from 32(0x20) to 62(0x3E) will protect 32B spaces in the region. Values from 0(0x00) to 31(0x1F) will protect whole region. This field is sticky 0.

KEY0 read protection configuration. 1024 bytes of KEY0 can be protected with granularity of 32Bytes. Protection is disabled for 63(0x3F). The values ranging from 32(0x20) to 62(0x3E) will protect 32B spaces in the region. Values from 0(0x00) to 31(0x1F) will protect whole region. This field is sticky 0.

register.description: Read Protect Trim

bitfield.description: CCFG read protection configuration. 1024 bytes of CCFG can be protected with granularity of 16Bytes. Protection is disabled for 63(0x3F). The values ranging from 32(0x20) to 62(0x3E) will protect 16B spaces in the region. Values from 0(0x00) to 31(0x1F) will protect whole region. This field is sticky 0.

FCFG read protection configuration. 1024 bytes of FCFG can be protected with granularity of 16Bytes. Protection is disabled for 63(0x3F). The values ranging from 32(0x20) to 62(0x3E) will protect 16B spaces in the region. Values from 0(0x00) to 31(0x1F) will protect whole region. This field is sticky 0.

register.description: Read Protect ENGR. This register is sticky 0

bitfield.description: ENGR read protection configuration.

register.description: Write Erase Protect Main for Bank-0 (Program Flash Bank-0). This register allows the first 32 sectors of the program flash bank 0 main region to be protected from program or erase, with 1 bit protecting each sector (sector 0 to sector 31). This register is sticky 0.

bitfield.description: Flash write/erase protection configuration value.

register.description: Write Erase Protect Main Bank 1 (Program Flash Bank-1). This register allows the first 32 sectors of the program flash bank 1 main region to be protected from program or erase, with 1 bit protecting each sector (sector 0 to sector 31). This register is sticky 0.

bitfield.description: Flash write/erase protection configuration value.

register.description: Write Erase Protect Main Bank 2 (Data Flash Bank). This register allows the first 8 sectors of the data flash bank main region to be protected from program or erase, with 1 bit protecting each sector (sector 0 to sector 7). This register is sticky 0.

bitfield.description: Flash write/erase protection configuration value.

register.description: Write Erase Protect Auxillary. Flash Write/Erase protection for Non-Main, TRIM and ENGR Regions. This register is sticky 0

bitfield.description: Write/Erase Protection for ENGR
Write/Erase Protection for MDATA
Write/Erase Protection for KEY1
Write/Erase Protection for KEY0
Write/Erase Protection for CCFG
Write/Erase Protection for FCFG

register.description: Flash Status. This register is used to indicate status of flash.

bitfield.description: Bank 2 Busy. This bit indicates if flash Bank 2 is busy.
Bank 1 Busy. This bit indicates if flash Bank 1 is busy.
Bank 0 Busy. This bit indicates if flash Bank 0 is busy.
Parity Error. This bit indicates parity error on write/erase & read protection MMRs. This bit is sticky when set to 1 by hardware.
This bit indicates if flash is busy.
Flash 2T Ready. This bit indicates if flash is ready in 2T mode.
Flash 1T Ready. This bit indicates if flash is ready in 1T mode.

register.description: Control Register.

bitfield.description: Swap Lock. If set, [CTL.SWAP] bit is blocked for writing. This bit is sticky 1
Swaps the logical to physical bank mapping. This bit has no effect if [CTL.SPLMODE] is 0 and is writable ony when [CTL.SWAPLOCK] is 0

register.description: Digital test bus control register. This register can be used to bring out IP internal signals to the pads for observation. 8 signals can be observed per select value.

bitfield.description: Digital test bus selection mux control. Non-zero select values output a 8 bit selected group of signals per value.
